basicInfo.description: AI-powered platform for personalized fitness and nutrition with progress tracking and recommendations from a virtual trainer

valueProposition.problem: People want to be healthy and fit but don't know where to start. Traditional gyms are expensive (€50-100/month), personal trainers cost €40-80/hour, and apps give generic advice without accounting for individual needs. 70% of people quit working out within 3 months due to lack of motivation and wrong approach.
valueProposition.solution: v24 is an AI platform that creates a personalized workout and nutrition plan based on your goals, fitness level, available time, and equipment. The app analyzes your data, tracks progress through photos and metrics, and automatically adjusts the program. A virtual trainer motivates you daily.
valueProposition.solutionUniqueness: Computer vision to analyze body shape through photos without scales. AI accounts for the user's psychological profile. Database of 500+ exercises adapted for health limitations. Integration with Apple Health, Fitbit, and other trackers.
advantages: AI-powered personalization: plan adapts to your goals, level, and progress
Computer vision: track progress through photos without scales or measurements
Affordable price: €19/month instead of €50-100 at a gym or €40-80/hour with a trainer
Convenience: work out at home, gym, or outdoors with no schedule constraints
Motivation: virtual trainer with daily reminders and support
valueProposition.measurableValue: Save €200-400/month compared to a gym. Save 5-10 hours per week. Users lose an average of 3-5 kg in 3 months. Probability of reaching goals increases from 30% to 75%.

customerSegments.primarySegment: People aged 25-45 living in European and US cities with above-average income (€30K+/year). Office workers with sedentary lifestyles who want to improve their health but don't have time for regular gym visits. B2C model.

marketSize.tamDescription: 500M people in developed countries × 20% interested in fitness × €50 avg check × 12 months = €2,500M
marketSize.samDescription: Europe and USA — 200M potential users × 10% willing to pay × €25 × 12 = €500M
marketSize.somDescription: 50,000 paying users in 3 years × €20 × 12 = €12M (2.4% of SAM)

geography.notes: Start with English-speaking markets (UK, USA), then localize to German and French within the first year

willingnessToPay.evidence: Survey of 200 potential users: 65% willing to pay €15-25/month. Landing page pre-orders: 1,200 registrations, 80 people paid annual plan at €149. Price testing: €9.99 too cheap, €29.99 too expensive, €19.99 optimal (8% conversion).

channels.salesChannel: Self-service through mobile app (iOS and Android) with Stripe integration. Free 7-day trial, then €19.99/month or €149/year.
channels.cacDescription: Google Ads €25/customer (CPC €1.2, 5% conversion), Instagram Ads €12/customer, SEO €5/customer, Referral program €3/customer
channels.marketingTools: PostHog, ConvertKit, Buffer, Google Analytics, App Store Connect, Google Play Console. Budget €150/month.
channels.marketingFunnel: 1000 visitors → 150 registrations (15%) → 90 downloads (60%) → 72 activations (80%) → 50 first workouts (70%) → 12-13 paying customers (25%). Bottleneck: trial to paid conversion.

revenueStreams.description: Premium plans with additional features (€49 one-time)

economics.revenuePricing: Three-tier model: Free (basic features), Basic €19.99/month (personal plan + tracker + trainer), Premium €29.99/month (all features + monthly dietitian consultation). Annual subscription with 35% discount.
economics.costBreakdown: Staff €4,500/month, Technology €800/month (AWS €200, OpenAI €300, analytics €150, App Store €150), Marketing €2,000/month, Office/Operations €300/month, Legal €200/month, R&D €200/month. Total burn rate: €8,000/month.

team.founderExperience: Ivan Petrov (CEO) — 8 years in IT marketing and sales, launched an e-commerce startup, MBA. Maria Sidorova (CTO) — 10 years in mobile app development, AI/ML experience, first startup.
team.specialists: Certified fitness trainer (5h/month), Dietitian (3h/month), AI/ML consultant (4h/month)
team.gaps: No VP Marketing (hiring in 6 months at €10K MRR, budget €60K/year). No Growth Marketer (hiring in 9 months). No Customer Success (hiring in 12 months).

resources.existing: Remote team. MacBook for each founder. Proprietary AI personalization algorithms. Database of 500+ exercises with videos. Patent on body shape analysis via photo (application filed). €75,000 cash.
resources.needed: App Store and Google Play accounts (done). Medical content certification (€2,000). Stripe (done). Branding (done). Total one-time costs: €2,624.
resources.techStack: Next.js 14 + TypeScript, React Native (iOS/Android), Supabase (PostgreSQL), AWS, OpenAI API, TensorFlow (computer vision). Fully cloud-based, auto-scaling to 100K users. GDPR compliant, SOC2 via AWS.
resources.dependencies: Critical dependency on OpenAI API. Mitigation: testing Claude and Gemini as alternatives, planning fine-tuned models in 12 months. AWS dependency — standard with alternatives available.

activities.production: 2-week sprints, CI/CD via GitHub Actions, 70% test coverage, releases every 2 weeks
activities.innovation: Monthly user interviews, quarterly roadmap planning, A/B testing of new features
activities.platform: 24/7 monitoring via AWS CloudWatch, auto-scaling, weekly backups
activities.marketing: 2 blog articles per week, daily Instagram/TikTok posts, weekly email newsletter, ongoing Google Ads campaigns
activities.operations: Email support SLA 24h, automated onboarding, Stripe payment processing, GDPR compliant data handling

competition.directCompetitors: 1. Freeletics (€34.99/month, 50M+ users) — no AI personalization, generic programs. 2. MyFitnessPal (€9.99/month, 200M+ users) — nutrition focus, weak workouts. 3. Noom (€19/month) — weight loss only, no strength training. 4. Nike Training Club (free) — no personalization or progress tracking.
competition.indirectCompetitors: Gyms (€50-100/month), personal trainers (€40-80/hour), YouTube (free, no structure), fitness books and articles.
competition.whyChooseYou: 1) Unique AI personalization with psychological profiling. 2) Computer vision for progress tracking without scales — innovation. 3) Price €19.99 — balance between Freeletics (€35) and MyFitnessPal (€10). 4) Comprehensive approach: workouts + nutrition + motivation. 5) Work out anywhere, anytime.
competition.defensibility: 1) Database of 500+ exercises with video (6 months of development). 2) Patent on body shape analysis. 3) Fine-tuned AI algorithms (4 months R&D). 4) First movers in AI + computer vision for fitness. 5) Network effects through referral program. Window: 12-18 months before major players copy the features.

risks.technical: OpenAI API instability (fallback: Claude/Gemini). Scaling beyond 10K users (Redis cache, async processing). Computer vision accuracy (continuous model improvement). Data security (GDPR, SOC2).
risks.financial: Only 9 months runway — critical (raise €200K within 3 months). OpenAI costs growing faster than revenue (prompt optimization, per-user limits). High churn (improve onboarding, push notifications).
risks.legal: Health advice without medical license (disclaimer: 'not medical advice'). GDPR for EU users (Supabase EU hosting). App Store terms may change (diversify to web). Data security (encryption, audits).
risks.market: Large players launch similar product (speed and niche focus). Fitness app trend fades (real value delivery). Economic crisis — people cut spending (competitive pricing). Competitors lower prices (differentiation through quality).
risks.team: Co-founder conflict (4-year vesting, clear role separation). CTO dependency (documentation, backup developer). Cannot hire VP Marketing (founders handle it until €20K MRR). Burnout (sustainable pace, weekends off).
risks.mitigation: Q1-Q2 2026: 1) Raise €200K seed (Jan-Mar). 2) Hire backup developer (Feb, €3K/month). 3) Claude integration as fallback (Mar). 4) Customer success process (Jan). 5) Legal review of ToS and disclaimers (Jan, €1K). 6) Improve onboarding via A/B testing (Feb).

growth.traction: 120 paying customers, €2,400 MRR, +20% MoM growth over 3 months, 8% monthly churn, NPS 58, CAC payback 2.5 months. MVP launched October 2025. 1,200 landing page registrations, 80 prepaid annual subscriptions. App Store rating 4.6/5.
growth.scalingPlan: Months 1-6: Product-led growth (freemium, referral program, SEO 30 articles, content). Months 7-12: Sales-assisted (VP Marketing, influencers, gym partnerships). Year 2: International expansion (German, French, US markets).
growth.newMarkets: Year 1: UK, Germany, France. Year 2: USA (500K+ potential users), segment 35-55 years. Year 3: B2B2C — white-label for corporations and insurance companies.
growth.paybackPeriod: Break-even: month 18 (600 customers, €12K MRR). ROI for seed investors: month 30. Projected IRR 40% annually at Year 5 exit with €15M valuation.
growth.targets12Months: 750 customers, €15K MRR (€180K ARR), team of 5, market share 0.15% of SAM
growth.targets24Months: 3,000 customers, €60K MRR (€720K ARR), team of 12, profitability 20% margin, Series A €1.5M
growth.targets36Months: 10,000 customers, €200K MRR (€2.4M ARR), team of 25, 30% margin (€720K profit/year)
